# `funding_consumption`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

Exact source amounts consumed by debits, outgoing transfer principal and credit reversals.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Immutable consumption identity. |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Account owning the consumed source. |
| `action_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Debit, transfer or reversed action consuming the source. |
| `reversal_action_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Set when the consumption belongs to the action's reversal. |
| `payment_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Consumed payment; exclusive with the other source columns. |
| `credit_bill_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Consumed settled credit note. |
| `funding_source_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Consumed adjustment, transfer or reversal source. |
| `amount` | `numeric(12,2)` | no |  | Exact positive amount consumed. |
| `consumed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Injected-clock instant of the consuming commit. |
